source_name: ОТП Банк — Організаційна структура / shareholder-stakeholder information (PDF)
why_relevant: A dated PDF ('Станом на 1 липня 2026 року') containing the bank's full organisational structure. This is the single highest-value artefact for the 'organization changes' topic in this cell: version-to-version diffs expose department creation, merger and elimination, not just named appointments.

source_name: Гід онлайн-послуг «Дія» / my.gov.ua — процедура реєстрації змін відомостей про юрособу
why_relevant: Documents the legal mechanics and required documents (board decision appointing the director) and the timing of a registered director change. Essential methodological context for interpreting how quickly a real appointment shows up in the register and what evidentiary artefacts exist behind it.

source_name: Ministry of Finance — dedicated competitive-selection announcement pages for a named bank
why_relevant: The legally required 'оголошення про проведення конкурсного відбору' for a specific state bank — carries the vacancy count, candidate requirements, deadline and the commission. This is the earliest datable signal of an upcoming board turnover, typically months before the appointment. A parallel page type announces the tender for the executive-search (headhunting) firm.

source_name: zakon.rada.gov.ua — NBU normative acts and resolutions (Положення про ліцензування, Положення про авторизацію)
why_relevant: Authoritative legal text defining fit-and-proper / business-reputation criteria and the approval procedure for bank and payment-provider managers. Needed to interpret and structure appointment signals, and rule changes are themselves regulatory-shift signals.

source_name: Business.diia.gov.ua entrepreneur handbook — institutional entries on payment-market bodies
why_relevant: State business portal that describes payment-market institutions and associations; a stable, government-hosted pointer layer for identifying the institutional actors and their official names/roles in the payment ecosystem.

source_name: NABU newsroom — General Assembly and committee-election announcements
why_relevant: The event-level, dated feed behind the governance pages: General Assembly reports announce newly elected Council members and priorities, and a separate release presents newly elected chairs of the 11 sectoral Committees (e.g. the Payment Technologies, Information Security and Anti-Payment-Fraud Committee, reported as headed by Dmytro Yanishevskyi). Each such release is a timestamped who-holds-what record naming the person's employer bank — exactly the A5 signal.

source_name: LinkedIn post permalinks as evidence artefacts (activity URLs)
why_relevant: Concrete demonstration that individual LinkedIn activity URLs are search-indexed and citable: this one identifies a named Deputy Chair of the Management Board / CIO of Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine. Such permalinks are the atomic evidence unit for this cell.

Work.ua publishes trend/forecast pieces built on its own vacancy database (e.g. 2026 labour-market trends). Gives a validated baseline against which our own counts can be sanity-checked, plus sector breakdowns we cannot compute ourselves.

source_name: PaySpace Magazine Awards (PSM Awards) — щорічна фінтех-премія
why_relevant: Annual awards lists name companies AND individual executives/experts recognised by the payments community — a cheap annual snapshot of who currently holds which senior role across Ukrainian fintech/payments, and a seed list for actor-map expansion.

source_name: State Audit Service of Ukraine (Держаудитслужба) monitoring data via Prozorro/BI
why_relevant: DASU monitoring decisions on specific tenders expose contested procurements, cancellations and re-tenders — signals that an IT or consulting programme at a state bank/agency is delayed or restructured. Accessible as a dataset inside BI Prozorro.

source_name: Antikor / investigative aggregators — payment-operator schemes and management exposure
why_relevant: Reveals-indirectly source: investigative/compromat aggregators name the beneficial owners and managers behind terminal networks and PSPs (EasyPay/FC Kontraktovyi Dim, City24/Swift Guarantee) that never publish org information. Low credibility, high lead value — must be corroborated against the register.

source_name: U.S.-Ukraine Business Council (USUBC) member-news — committee election announcements
why_relevant: Republishes member firms' announcements of association/committee appointments in English, often persisting after the originating page rotates. Useful as an archival mirror and for cross-checking dates on committee-chair elections.
